typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		SRC_SYS_MEMBER_NBR as string,
		CLM_STATEMENT_BEGIN_DT as timestamp,
		CLM_LINE_PROC_CD as string,
		SRC_SYS_PROVIDER_NBR as string,
		CLM_LINE_PROC_CODESET_CD as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ UNCOMMITTED  SELECT DISTINCT 	SBSB.SBSB_ID + \'00\' AS SRC_SYS_MEMBER_NBR,  	CDML.IPCD_ID AS CLM_LINE_PROC_CD,  	CASE WHEN IPCD.IPCD_TYPE = \'T\' THEN \'ICD10\' ELSE \'ICD9\' END AS CLM_LINE_PROC_CODESET_CD,  	CLCL.CLCL_LOW_SVC_DT AS CLM_STATEMENT_BEGIN_DT,  	CLCL.PRPR_ID AS SRC_SYS_PROVIDER_NBR  FROM PDS_OB_TERM_CODES OC 	INNER JOIN ODW.DW.FAC_CMC_IPCD_PROC_CD IPCD ON OC.OB_TERM_CODES_CODE_VALUE = IPCD.IPCD_ID 		AND OC.OB_TERM_CODES_CODE_TYPE = \'PROC\' 		AND ((IPCD.IPCD_TYPE = \'T\' AND OC.OB_TERM_CODES_CODESET_CD = \'ICD10\') OR (IPCD.IPCD_TYPE IN (\'I\',\' \') AND OC.OB_TERM_CODES_CODESET_CD = \'ICD9\')) 	INNER JOIN ODW.DW.FAC_CMC_CDML_CL_LINE CDML ON CDML.IPCD_ID = IPCD.IPCD_ID  	INNER JOIN ODW.DW.FAC_CMC_CLCL_CLAIM CLCL ON CDML.CLCL_ID = CLCL.CLCL_ID 		AND CLCL.CLCL_LOW_SVC_DT > ? 	INNER JOIN ODW.DW.FAC_CMC_SBSB_SUBSC SBSB ON CLCL.SBSB_CK = SBSB.SBSB_CK',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> ODWProcData
ODWProcData derive(CodeType = 'PROC') ~> AddCodeType
AddCodeType derive(CodeType = CodeType) ~> PlaceHolderRowCount
PlaceHolderRowCount sink(input(
		OB_MEMBERTERMCODES_CODESET_CD as string,
		OB_MEMBERTERMCODES_MEMBERNUMBER as string,
		OB_MEMBERTERMCODES_CODE_DATE as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		OB_MEMBERTERMCODES_CODE_TYPE as string,
		OB_MEMBERTERMCODES_CODE_VALUE as string,
		OB_MEMBERTERMCODES_PROVIDER_NBR as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		OB_MEMBERTERMCODES_CODESET_CD = CLM_LINE_PROC_CODESET_CD,
		OB_MEMBERTERMCODES_MEMBERNUMBER = SRC_SYS_MEMBER_NBR,
		OB_MEMBERTERMCODES_CODE_DATE = CLM_STATEMENT_BEGIN_DT,
		OB_MEMBERTERMCODES_CODE_TYPE = CodeType,
		OB_MEMBERTERMCODES_CODE_VALUE = CLM_LINE_PROC_CD,
		OB_MEMBERTERMCODES_PROVIDER_NBR = SRC_SYS_PROVIDER_NBR)) ~> PDSOBMEMBERTERMCODESSTAGING
